repos.name: mikehasa/agentacct
repos.description: See what your coding agents did and what it cost. Breaks each task down into work steps — tools used, files changed, tests run, time and tokens spent. Local-first dashboard for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and more. No login, no telemetry.
repos.one_liner: A local-first observability and cost-tracking dashboard for AI coding agents.
bullets: Built with Python, providing a local-first dashboard to monitor agent activity.
Tracks granular metrics including token consumption, latency, and financial cost per task.
Integrates with popular coding agents like Claude Code and Codex to audit work steps, file changes, and test results.
Enables developers to optimize agent performance and manage operational budgets for AI-driven development.
repos.img_alt: agentacct tui — live usage, cost, provider rate-limit bars, and recent sessions with per-session weekly-plan-cost estimates
repos.img2_alt: agentacct tui session detail — the per-step work ledger with pass/fail check evidence and a weekly-plan-cost estimate

repos.name: simonlin1212/vibe-astock
repos.description: A 股短线复盘看板：涨停池·连板梯队·龙虎榜·板块资金一屏看完，赚钱效应/晋级率/梯队断层/情绪周期等派生指标纯计算直出（不经过 AI），AI 只把数据串成能读的盘面研判。全本地运行，可用 Claude/Codex 订阅免 API key。| A-share short-term daily-review dashboard: derived sentiment metrics computed locally, AI only writes the narrative. No API key needed.
repos.one_liner: A high-performance, local-first dashboard for A-share market sentiment analysis and short-term trading review.
bullets: Uses a hybrid architecture: deterministic Python-based computation for market metrics and LLMs for narrative synthesis.
Calculates complex sentiment indicators like market breadth, ladder effects, and liquidity cycles locally.
Provides a comprehensive visualization of market 'money flow' and 'profit effects' without relying on external API-heavy data feeds.
Ideal for quantitative traders needing to visualize market sentiment and liquidity dynamics in real-time.

repos.name: Flaminis/Dalaran
repos.description: Dalaran — Apache-2.0, robotics-first visualization and data infrastructure for multimodal time-series. ROS 2 native, reads existing .rrd recordings. A hard fork of Rerun.
repos.one_liner: A robotics-first, high-performance visualization and data infrastructure for multimodal time-series data.
bullets: Rust-based architecture designed as a high-performance fork of Rerun, optimized for time-series data.
Native ROS 2 support, allowing for seamless integration with existing robotics and sensor data pipelines.
Capable of reading and visualizing legacy .rrd recordings, making it highly compatible with existing research workflows.
Useful for finance professionals analyzing high-frequency tick data or complex sensor-based market signals.
